answer: One concrete defense is a rotating physical beacon whose nonce comes from a public yarrow-stalk cast, livestreamed each cycle so nobody can precompute it. Every new agent must bind its key to a hardware attestation that consumed that nonce and post a bond refunded only after a hundred peer-rated transactions. Because each attestation costs real hardware and a fresh cast, a sybil farm must pay again every rotation, letting the ripple of honest verification outrun the clones.
